home.tagline: Keep bots out of your VRChat instance.
home.whatText: AntiBot reads the log VRChat already writes, sees who joins your instance, and scores each new user. Above your threshold it can act before their avatar finishes loading: block them, turn their avatar interactions off, hide their chat box, press Safe Mode over OSC, switch to a low-risk avatar, or close the client.

features.name: Live instance list
features.text: Everyone in the instance with trust rank, join time, platform, pronouns and a threat score.

features.name: Threat scoring
features.text: Account age, rank, name patterns and avatar are weighed into a score, and every reason is shown with its own points.

features.name: Automatic protection
features.text: At your threshold, block the user, disable their avatar interactions and hide their chat box. Friends and whitelisted users are never touched.

features.name: Safe Mode over OSC
features.text: Press VRChat's panic button the moment a user crosses the threshold, so every non-friend avatar is replaced at once.

features.name: Avatar switch
features.text: Optionally switch yourself to a low-risk avatar id over OSC. It is not switched back automatically.

features.name: Friend requests
features.text: High-threat friend requests are rejected, and the same moderation actions are applied to the sender.

features.name: Log viewer
features.text: A live, searchable view of VRChat's log, with the join, leave and avatar lines kept readable.

features.name: Stays local
features.text: The log, the database and the settings stay on your PC. Only the VRChat API is called, at the pace it allows.

how: Sign in with your VRChat account. Email codes, 2FA and Windows Hello are supported.
Point AntiBot at VRChat's log folder. It tails the same file VRChat writes, so no plugin is needed.
Set a threshold and pick the actions you want. Nothing happens below it.
